answer: Proof of Space-Time resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to seal unique data sectors tied to its public key and answer random Merkle audits across an epoch horizon. Peers verify succinct proofs before routing tasks, separating committed nodes from disposable clones like jade from copper. Attackers incur the verifiable cost of dedicating physical storage capacity and disk I/O per identity. However, well-funded operators can still rent cloud storage or pool idle drives to host extra agents.
